rumours: Travellers in Dune whisper that old toll-charters across Anequina are being bought up by secretive factors.
Watchmen along the Anequina trails say lanterns have been seen moving inside the ancient vaults after midnight.
Stewards serving Clan-Mother Ahzirr posted fresh commissions at Dune for anyone who can secure the outlying ruins of Anequina.
Wayfarers resting in Anequina swear the roadside shrines hum softly whenever a storm rolls across the border.
Clerks in Dune complain that sealed crates bypass the customs posts of the Well-Clans of Anequina without inspection.
Local folk in Anequina still leave an offering on the boundary stones to keep the older spirits quiet.
A chronicler arrived in Dune last week asking after First and Second Era garrison rolls for Anequina.
Apothecaries in Dune pay good silver for rare moss and resin gathered from the ruins of Anequina.
Veterans in Dune still debate which company held the frontier pass of Anequina during the Crisis.
Smugglers working the back-tracks of Anequina use chipped milestones to mark their midnight drop-sites.
legends: In the First Era, when the earliest boundary stones were raised across Anequina, the watchtowers of the Well-Clans of Anequina echoed with bronze horns for seven nights.
Old ballads of Dune tell of a standard-bearer who sealed his company's charter chest beneath a stronghold in Anequina and swore never to yield the key.
Folk in Anequina speak of the Twilight Surveyor, a phantom chronicler who walks the milestones toward Dune during Frostfall, measuring whether the old pacts still hold.
Beneath the oldest foundations of Dune, builders claim an unbroken subterranean conduit still links the shrines of Anequina.
During the Second Era interregnum, an envoy of the Well-Clans of Anequina walked alone into the deepest ruin of Anequina and returned with the truce-ring that still hangs in Dune.
Every century when the moons align over Anequina, the sunken bells near Dune are said to chime three times beneath the earth.
Carvers in Dune preserve the tale of the First Warden of Anequina, who traded his shadow to seal the lower fault-gates against intruders.
According to the temple rolls of Dune, the oldest road through Anequina follows the footprints of the ancestors who first named the land.

songs.title: The High Road to Dune
lines: O the road to Dune winds ancient and long,
Where the wardens of Anequina still march with a song;
Keep your lantern trimmed bright through the mist and the rain,
Till the gates of Dune rise before us again.

songs.title: Watchfires of Anequina
lines: Raise a cup for Anequina, where the old beacons gleam,
Above ruin and valley, by causeway and stream;
Though the borderlands shift and the smugglers may scheme,
Still the folk of Dune keep the ancestors' dream.

songs.title: Boundary Stones of Dune
lines: From the pass to the harbour the mile-pillars stand,
Cut by chisels of old across Anequina's proud land;
Count the leagues into Dune with steel in your hand,
For the spirits of Anequina bow to no stranger's command.

songs.title: Lamplight in Dune
lines: When the dusk settles deep over Anequina's wide shore,
And the barges tie fast by the customhouse door;
May the wards of Dune hold the night-wind at bay,
Till the horns of the morningwatch welcome the day.

abode_of_ignominy.hook: Travelers in Anequina report activity around Abode Of Ignominy, a dark necromancer ritualist crypt.
abode_of_ignominy.rumour: Wayfarers near Abode Of Ignominy speak of sealed caches inside this dark necromancer ritualist crypt.
abode_of_ignominy.quest: Investigate the reports surrounding Abode of Ignominy in Anequina and report to the wardens at Dune.

notes.title: Surveyor's Field-Log at Abode of Ignominy
notes.author: Geographical Chroniclers' Guild
pages: On the fourteenth day of our circuit through Anequina, we set our transit-rod at Abode of Ignominy (survey grid -900, 11150 under the Well-Clans of Anequina). The foundations here show three distinct strata of occupation, and our local guide from Dune refused to camp within forty paces of the threshold after sundown.

notes.title: Warden's Dispatch: Abode of Ignominy
notes.author: Chancery of Dune
pages: To the watch-corporal posted at Abode of Ignominy (-900, 11150): by warrant of Clan-Mother Ahzirr in Dune, patrols along this sector of Anequina are to inspect all night-convoys bearing unsealed casks and report any broken boundary stones to the Well-Clans of Anequina.

notes.title: Factor's Private Missive from Abode of Ignominy
notes.author: Factor-Clerk Vorian
pages: My dear colleague in Dune: the inventory cached at Abode of Ignominy (grid -900, 11150 in Anequina) remains untouched by the bailiffs of the Well-Clans of Anequina. So long as the border watches stay occupied, our drovers can move two dozen crates a week past Abode of Ignominy without paying toll.

notes.title: Antiquarian Notes on Abode of Ignominy
notes.author: Chronicler Mirabelle of the Archives
pages: Among the secondary sites of Anequina, Abode of Ignominy (situated at coordinates -900, 11150 within the jurisdiction of the Well-Clans of Anequina) merits closer study. The stonework preserves tool-marks characteristic of early regional craft oriented toward Dune.

notes.title: Wayfarer's Warning at Abode of Ignominy
notes.author: Road-Warden of Dune
pages: Travellers bound for Dune across Anequina: do not unhitch your teams at Abode of Ignominy (-900, 11150) after the evening mist rises. Outriders of the Well-Clans of Anequina reported hostile movement inside the perimeter of Abode of Ignominy last fortnight.

notes.title: Rubbing from the Boundary Stone at Abode of Ignominy
notes.author: Wayshrine Chronicler
pages: Transcribed from the weathered lintel at Abode of Ignominy (-900, 11150 in Anequina): 'Here stands the watch-stone of the Well-Clans of Anequina, raised to guard the approach to Dune. Let whoever takes shelter within these walls keep the lamp lit and the threshold clean.'

notes.title: Tithe and Toll Roll of Abode of Ignominy
notes.author: Assize Bailiff of Dune
pages: Extracted from the regional assessment book for Abode of Ignominy (grid -900, 11150 in Anequina): twelve loads of dressed stone, four casks of lamp-oil, and eighteen silver pieces remitted to the Well-Clans of Anequina at Dune.

notes.title: Scout's Night-Watch Report: Abode of Ignominy
notes.author: Outrider of the Well-Clans of Anequina
pages: Submitted to the guard-captain at Dune: at midnight we observed lantern-signals flashing from the upper masonry of Abode of Ignominy (-900, 11150 in Anequina). Fresh tracks lead from the threshold toward the main road.

notes.title: Tithe and Toll Roll of Zual Cave
notes.author: Assize Bailiff of Senchal
pages: Extracted from the regional assessment book for Zual Cave (grid 3206, 12309 in Senchal): twelve loads of dressed stone, four casks of lamp-oil, and eighteen silver pieces remitted to the Maritime Court of Senchal at Senchal.

notes.title: Scout's Night-Watch Report: Zual Cave
notes.author: Outrider of the Maritime Court of Senchal
pages: Submitted to the guard-captain at Senchal: at midnight we observed lantern-signals flashing from the upper masonry of Zual Cave (3206, 12309 in Senchal). Fresh tracks lead from the threshold toward the main road.
